# WE CARE TO MAKE THE WORLD A HEALTHIER AND SAFER PLACE

## A worldwide provider of X-ray imaging systems for medical, non-destructive testing and precision
## contract coating services for a wide range of industrial, medical and electronic applications.



[ Medical Imaging ][61] [ Non-Destructive Testing ][62] [ Contract Manufacturing ][63]

## Innovation. Quality. Trust.

**Carestream is a vibrant global company with a proven history of superb imaging technology and
unparalleled service.**

That history is now poised to continue, creating imaging solutions that provide our customers with
quantifiable gains and real-world benefits. Carestream has always been here for you. We always will
be. Together, let’s continue to shape the future of imaging.
* [Board of Directors][64]
* [Executive Biographies][65]
* [Company History][66]
* [Company Profile (PDF)][67]

## Feature Spotlight

**[Smart Noise Cancellation for Superb Image Quality.][68]**

[ [Quality Solutions Built to Address Real Voice of Customer Needs] ][69]

**Provides clear, easier-to-read images for improved diagnostic confidence.**

Enables customers to lower radiation dose without loss in image quality. Performance validated in an
internal study with **50%** dose reduction from 220 IEC EI on average.*

[Learn More][70]

[Smart Noise Cancellation Brochure (PDF)][71]

## Latest Press Release

**Rochester, NY. May 21, 2026**

[ [Carestream Highlights Continued Business Momentum and Confidence] ][72]

**Carestream Highlights Continued Business Momentum and Confidence**


Following a comprehensive refinancing earlier this year, Carestream Health has received an upgrade
of its Corporate Family Rating and its outlook from Moody’s. The update reflects [[...][73]]
* [Read the full Release][74]
* [All News Releases][75]

* These statements were validated using Carestream CsI detectors in reader studies conducted by
board-certified radiologists. Pairwise comparisons were performed between images at nominal exposure
dose without SNC and at 50% reduced dose with SNC. The reduced-dose images included live patient
images with simulated dose reduction, as well as images of human cadavers and anthropomorphic
phantoms obtained using actual reduced-dose X-ray exposures. SNC performance was further confirmed
using a CDRAD phantom. IEC EI values on average at nominal and reduced dose were 220 and 110,
respectively.

# [Who’s Reading My Chest X-ray?][76]

## New CDC Proposal Suggests Allowing Physician Assistants and Nurse Practitioners to Read Chest
## X-rays.

*By Ann London BS. RT (R)(T) | Clinical Applications Specialist, Carestream*

The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s National Institute for Occupational Safety and
Health (NIOSH) is deciding on expanding their federal program known as the “B Reader Program.” This
program trains and certifies physicians to read chest radiographs […]

[Read the full blog][77]

dose without SNC and at 50% reduced dose with SNC. The reduced-dose images included live patient
images with simulated dose reduction, as well as images of human cadavers and anthropomorphic
phantoms obtained using actual reduced-dose X-ray exposures. SNC performance was further confirmed
using a CDRAD phantom. IEC EI values on average at nominal and reduced dose were 220 and 110,
respectively.

Adaptive radiotherapy is changing what’s possible in cancer treatment.

Elekta is making it work in routine clinical practice, combining precision, workflow and evidence to
help centers deliver adaptive care as a new standard.

[Adaptive Radiotherapy][225]

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

# Nobody does
# adaptive
# like **Elekta**

Adaptive radiotherapy is changing what’s possible in cancer treatment.

Elekta is making it work in routine clinical practice, combining precision, workflow and evidence to
help centers deliver adaptive care as a new standard.

[Adaptive Radiotherapy][225]

Your browser does not support HTML video..

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

of cancer**.

Siemens Healthineers is focused on elevating cancer care across the entire patient journey. By
enhancing the patient experience, enabling more personalized care, streamlining clinical workflows,
and making innovation accessible, we help care teams to improve outcomes for **a world without fear
of cancer**.

See how a connected cancer care approach turns growing complexity into coordinated action and
confident care — for patients, families, and care teams.

## See through to the future.

 

Radiology is always advancing, driven every day by new demands, challenges, and possibilities. And
with every advancement radiology makes, Agfa takes it further. So when radiology teams are asked to
do more, faster, with fewer resources — all while delivering the highest diagnostic quality — they
have what they need: Clarity. Perspective. And confidence in what comes next.

 

Each week, more than 3 million radiographic exams are carried out with Agfa technology worldwide. We
make each one count by combining intelligent automation, streamlined workflows and seamless
integration. The right information is available precisely when it’s needed. Radiology doesn’t pause.
Neither do we. See Through to the Future.

### How our technologies make the difference …

[
][106]
[

#### **MUSICA™**: Gold standard image processing

][107]

**MUSICA™** automatically analyzes the characteristics of each raw image and optimizes the
processing parameters, independent of body part or dose deviation. It enhances noise suppression,
offers superb brightness control, reduces veiling glare, and plays a significant role in enabling
potential dose reduction. The result is excellent image quality compared to standard image
processing, representing bone and soft issue in a balanced way.

[Learn more ][108]
[
][109]
[

#### **SmartXR™**: The intelligent radiography workflow assistant

][110]

The **SmartXR™** portfolio offers digital radiography tools for dose, alignment, patient
positioning, image rotation and more. These provide the radiographer with predictive workflow
assistance that helps improve operational performance in image acquisition.

[Learn more ][111]
[
][112]
[

#### **SupportXR™**: DR Service, by Agfa Experts

][113]

Downtime means disruption. Prevention is the best protection. And with the right service plan in
place, you can ensure fast, reliable recovery, keeping operations running smoothly – even in the
face of unexpected events.

[Learn more ][114]
[
][115]
[

#### **ScanXR™**: Early notification of pathologies and diseases

][116]

By identifying suspicious critical pathologies and diseases, **CriticalScan™** ensures that images
with key diagnostic information can be immediately marked as high priority at the point of care.
Enhanced pathology visualization enables fast and improved patient outcomes.

**DensityScan™** enables earlier identification of patients with a high risk of osteoporosis, during
ordinary X-ray imaging. It helps bridge the diagnosis gap for osteoporosis: to improve patients’
quality of life, ensure healthcare equity, and enable significant healthcare cost savings.

[Learn more ][117]

Enhanced pathology visualization enables fast and improved patient outcomes.

**DensityScan™** enables earlier identification of patients with a high risk of osteoporosis, during
ordinary X-ray imaging. It helps bridge the diagnosis gap for osteoporosis: to improve patients’
quality of life, ensure healthcare equity, and enable significant healthcare cost savings.

## SERVICES

### Consultation

Creating a Custom Application is mainly for improving the customer interface with usage of Creo. The
main objective to create Creo custom Application is to identifying the pain points of the customer
and giving them the best point solutions. Thus by the enhancement on Creo by providing the Point
solution helps the customer to perform the work easier, quicker and errorless.

### Training & Certification

Jump Start your career in Product Design by learning Creo (Pro/ENGINEER) from the Experts. We
provide classroom training in PTC products in house & also in customer locations. We also mentor the
engineers to enrich their knowledge in PTC products & thus enhancing the utilisation of CAD & the
engineering resources.

### Implementation

Breakthrough products demand more from your business. They demand more from engineering: like the
need to bring together multidisciplinary teams to collaborate more closely than ever before on the
design of today's highly integrated hardware, software, and connected systems. And they demand more
from the rest of your organization: like the process efficiency needed to deliver your cutting-edge
products to market faster and to earn your company first-mover advantage in the marketplace.
Finally, breakthrough products demand more from your enterprise technologies: like the ability to
integrate and execute on these multifaceted demands with an approach that scales to your business
and doesn't slow down its users.

### ODC

Our Offshore Design Centre will help you to manage and give an added advantage to your Business,
through parallel Engineering Processes.
* Concurrent development on constant project by your team and CADOpt Technologies Limited' team.
* Engineer adjoining expertise though our Engineers are settled offshore.
* Minimal to zero onsite engineers.
* Extensive use of Video Conference, information sharing and live communication tools facilitating
  the next level of data sharing and interaction.

### COE
* Assistance in Human Capital Skill Development.
* To enable unskilled and semi-skilled people to earn better livelihood for social upliftment.
* Impart high end modern technical skills and knowledge to create industry ready human capital.
* Equip the government and private institutions such as engineering institutes, polytechnics and ITI
  by creating high-end assets for human capital formation.
* Collaborate with PTC and CADOpt to establish CoE by offering nominal contribution and facilitate
  institutional co-operation

## From Art to Part: CADOpt’s Proven Methodology

CADOpt Technologies transforms engineering ideas into reality through our ART TO PART
approach—delivering measurable value across industries. We have earned the trust of leading
industrial and government organizations.

#### Software Solutions

Design Process Automation
& Custom Applications

Collaborative Learning

With solutions like CAD, PLM, IoT & AR technologies working together, digital processes enable the
analysis, management & communication of information across cross-functional groups so that decisions
can be made faster & with greater accuracy and with ease.

Work Group Manager helps integrating softwares like SolidEdge, ZWCAD, BricsCAD with Windchill PLM.
This certainly gives a competitive edge as this Work Group Manager(WGM) utility choose and fine tune
the technology employed with Windchill.

Technology is changing, and embracing the technology is the need of the hour to keep pace with the
market demand and growing competition.

It goes without saying that "Digital transformation" is one of the key differentiators which most of
the companies' stake holders are considering in their strategic business plan towards success. The
world is witnessing major global shifts towards Digital solutions to reduce operational costs,
maximize revenue growth, and increase efficiency in streamlined and effective ways.

Intensive competition in the market has put great pressure on the manufacturing industry to develop,
produce and deliver products that meet requirements of the customers. Companies have realized that
the design automation and CAD customizations are powerful tools that shorten the lead time,
optimizes the design process, improves product efficiency and resulting in ultimate decreased cost.

Current industry trends suggest that companies are adapting new technologies & technical
enhancements at a rapid pace like never before. For an individual or an organization to be a
formidable player in such a competitive environment, continuous learning and skill enablement is no
more an option but imperative.

## INDUSTRIES WE WORK

We worked on Aerospace & Defense, Automotive, Healthcare, Industrial, Oil Industry, Gas Industry,
Energy Industry, Tooling And Manufacturing and Engineering Services.

## CHANNEL PARTNER

[PTC]

CADOpt Technologies is a Premium Solution Provider and Top Value-Added Reseller for PTC in India.
With PTC, global manufacturers and an ecosystem of partners and developers can capitalize on this
promise of physical-digital convergence today and drive the future of innovation.

[Cadence]

CADOpt Technologies is a strategic Cadence partner in India, helping manufacturers unlock smarter
workflows, reduce operational inefficiencies, and make faster, data-driven decisions with Cadence’s
intelligent solutions.

[Graebert]

CADOpt Technologies is a growing Graebert partner in India. In a world increasingly dominated by 3D
models and globalization, Graebert solutions enable 2D CAD users to manage their digital
transformation smoothly, leveraging mobile and cloud technologies to improve collaboration and
create smarter DWG drawings able to work in synergy with BIM and 3D models.

[iSEEK]

CADOpt Technologies is the exclusive partner of iSEEK Corporation in India, delivering high-speed,
shape-based search and analytics that transform how CAD data is accessed and utilized. iSEEK’s
innovative technology encodes 3D geometry to streamline operations, enhance compatibility, and
accelerate decision-making.

# Our technology brings quality screening to those **who need it most.**

With end-to-end diagnostics solutions, artificial intelligence, and local partnerships, we make
early detection possible in the
hardest-to-reach places.

[ How we help ][148] [ Contact us ][149]
[Patients queue to be registered for screening in Nepal.]

## Impact first.** Always.**

When access to healthcare is out of reach, the consequences are immediate. That is why we build
diagnostic solutions that help bring care closer: to communities, clinicians, and health systems
working under pressure every day. We are a social enterprise, driven by the belief that quality
healthcare should not depend on location or infrastructure.

Our innovations are designed to respond to pressing healthcare needs, particularly those of key and
vulnerable populations in resource-constrained settings.

# Our technology brings quality screening to those **who need it most.**

With end-to-end diagnostics solutions, artificial intelligence, and local partnerships, we make
early detection possible in the
hardest-to-reach places.

[ How we help ][148] [ Contact us ][149]
[Patients queue to be registered for screening in Nepal.]

## Impact first.** Always.**

When access to healthcare is out of reach, the consequences are immediate. That is why we build
diagnostic solutions that help bring care closer: to communities, clinicians, and health systems
working under pressure every day. We are a social enterprise, driven by the belief that quality
healthcare should not depend on location or infrastructure.

Our innovations are designed to respond to pressing healthcare needs, particularly those of key and
vulnerable populations in resource-constrained settings.

### What Does a Cosmetic Physician Do?

A cosmetic physician is a doctor who specialises in non-surgical interventions whose primary

### Cosmetic Surgery

A cosmetic surgeon is a surgeon who specialises in performing surgery with the primary intention of
changing a patient’s appearance in the absence of any disease

can subside after a few days taking it easy

## High Lakes Health Care Joins Wellness Wednesdays


We’re excited to announce a new way to connect with you! Starting Wednesday, April 29th, High Lakes
Health Care will sponsor Wellness Wednesdays, a weekly health segment airing on KBNZ (CBS) and KOHD
(ABC).

Every Wednesday morning at 5:25am and 6:25am, learn more about practical wellness advice, answers to
common health questions, and provide timely tips to help Central Oregon families stay healthy
throughout the seasons.

**When to Watch:**
* KBNZ (CBS) at 5:25am and 6:25am
* KOHD (ABC) at 5:25am and 6:25am
* Also airing during Good Morning America (7am-9am)

## High Lakes Health Care is Dedicated to Providing Your Family the Best Medical Care

High Lakes Health Care is an independent primary care practice dedicated to providing accessible and
quality health care to people of all ages in and around Bend, OR. Part of, Praxis Medical Group, we
are independent providers who have joined together to create a higher level of care experience for
the patient, patient’s family, and the communities we serve. Whether you need an annual checkup or
you have a complex health condition, the board-certified physicians at High Lakes Health Care are
ready to treat you from head to toe and coordinate your care every step of the way.

## Specializing in Primary Care, Women’s Health and More

Focusing on gynecology, internal medicine, cardiology, and urgent care services, our physicians are
committed to building long-lasting relationships with their patients and families. Furthermore,
every provider in our practice is dedicated to making improvements to healthcare and going above and
beyond for our patients. From the moment you walk in the door your health is our primary concern. In
addition, we are conveniently located for the well-being of our communities of Bend, Sisters, and
Redmond, Oregon. We are here to serve you and empower you to live a healthier, longer and more
productive life.

## High Lakes Health Care Joins Wellness Wednesdays


We’re excited to announce a new way to connect with you! Starting Wednesday, April 29th, High Lakes
Health Care will sponsor Wellness Wednesdays, a weekly health segment airing on KBNZ (CBS) and KOHD
(ABC).

common health questions, and provide timely tips to help Central Oregon families stay healthy
throughout the seasons.

## High Lakes Health Care is Dedicated to Providing Your Family the Best Medical Care

High Lakes Health Care is an independent primary care practice dedicated to providing accessible and
quality health care to people of all ages in and around Bend, OR. Part of, Praxis Medical Group, we
are independent providers who have joined together to create a higher level of care experience for
the patient, patient’s family, and the communities we serve. Whether you need an annual checkup or
you have a complex health condition, the board-certified physicians at High Lakes Health Care are
ready to treat you from head to toe and coordinate your care every step of the way.

## Specializing in Primary Care, Women’s Health and More

Focusing on gynecology, internal medicine, cardiology, and urgent care services, our physicians are
committed to building long-lasting relationships with their patients and families. Furthermore,
every provider in our practice is dedicated to making improvements to healthcare and going above and
beyond for our patients. From the moment you walk in the door your health is our primary concern. In
addition, we are conveniently located for the well-being of our communities of Bend, Sisters, and
Redmond, Oregon. We are here to serve you and empower you to live a healthier, longer and more
productive life.

# All-in-One Online PDF Tools

## Edit, convert, OCR, and manage PDF files directly in your browser — fast, free, and secure

One online platform for every PDF task

i2PDF is an all-in-one online PDF toolkit that helps you edit, convert, compress, OCR, and manage
PDF files without installing software.

i2PDF is a browser-based PDF platform designed to handle everyday document tasks quickly and
securely. Whether you need to edit PDF pages, convert files to and from PDF, enhance scanned
documents with OCR, or prepare PDFs for sharing and printing, i2PDF provides simple tools that work
entirely online. No downloads, no sign-ups, and no technical knowledge required — just upload your
file and get the job done.

* Edit PDF files by adding text, images, annotations, and signatures

* Compress PDF files to reduce size without losing quality
* Improve scanned PDFs using OCR, deskew, and contrast enhancement
* Prepare PDF documents for printing, sharing, and long-term storage

## Why Use i2PDF
* Free online PDF tools with no software installation
* Works on Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile devices
* Designed for speed, simplicity, and everyday productivity
* Supports editing, conversion, and scanning workflows in one place
* Secure processing with automatic file deletion
* Ideal for students, professionals, and small teams

## Built for Reliable, Everyday PDF Work
* Used worldwide for common PDF editing and conversion tasks
* No registration required for basic PDF tools
* Files are processed securely and removed automatically
* Optimized for fast, browser-based document workflows
* Part of the i2PDF online productivity tool ecosystem

## Frequently Asked Questions

Is i2PDF free to use? + −

Yes. i2PDF provides free online PDF tools that work directly in your browser without installation.

Do I need to create an account? + −

No. All i2PDF tools can be used without signing up or logging in.

Are my PDF files secure? + −

Yes. Uploaded files are processed securely and deleted automatically after 30 minutes from
processing.

Can I use i2PDF on mobile devices? + −

Yes. i2PDF works on modern browsers across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Do I need to install any software? + −

No. All PDF tools run entirely online in your browser—no downloads or installations required.

Is there a file size limit? + −

i2PDF accepts PDF files with a maximum size of 500 MB and images with a maximum size of 50 MB.

Will my PDF quality change after processing? + −

i2PDF tools are designed to preserve original quality whenever possible. Some tools, like
compression or optimization, may reduce file size while maintaining visual clarity.

Can I use i2PDF for work or school documents? + −

Yes. i2PDF is commonly used by students, professionals, and businesses for everyday PDF editing,
conversion, and organization tasks.

Does i2PDF support multiple languages? + −

Yes. i2PDF tools support multiple languages, including OCR for many international scripts.

What happens if my upload fails? + −

If an upload or processing step fails, you can retry the operation or contact help at
admin@sciweavers.org. No files are permanently stored on the server.

How long does PDF processing take? + −

Most PDF tasks complete within seconds, depending on file size, tool type, and internet connection.

If you cannot find an answer to your question, please contact us
admin@sciweavers.org

# **LibreCAD**

## Open Source 2D-CAD

**LibreCAD** is a free Open Source CAD application for Windows, Apple and Linux. Support and
documentation are free from our large, dedicated community of users, contributors and developers.

**You, too, can also get involved!**




[LibreCAD Screen Shot]
[LibreCAD Splash Screen]

# About us

## How it started

**LibreCAD** started as a project to build CAM capabilities into the community version of QCad for
use with a Mechmate CNC router.

Since QCad CE was built around the outdated Qt3 library, it had to be ported to Qt4 before
additional enhancements. This gave rise to CADuntu.

The project was known as CADuntu only for a couple of months before the community decided that the
name was inappropriate. After some discussion within the community and research on existing names,
CADuntu was renamed to **LibreCAD**.

Porting the rendering engine to Qt4 proved to be a large task, so **LibreCAD** initially still
depended on the Qt3 support library. The Qt4 porting was completed eventually during the development
of 2.0.0 series, thanks to our master developer Rallaz, and **LibreCAD** has become Qt3 free except
in the 1.0.0 series.

Meanwhile, for **LibreCAD** 2.2.0 series, Qt5 is mandatory.

# LibreCAD Features

**LibreCAD** is a feature-packed and mature 2D-CAD application with some really great advantages:

## Completely and Utterly Free

No worries about trials, subscriptions, license costs or annual fees.

## Open Source and GPLv2

Developed by an experienced team and supported by an awesome community, **LibreCAD** is also free to
hack and copy.

## No Language Barriers

It's available in over 30 languages with cross-platform support for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

# LibreCAD Download

## macOS

**Help is needed for macOS deployment.**

[ from GitHub ][22]
Find latest stable DMG packages there.

## Windows

[ from GitHub ][23]
Find latest stable EXE installer there.
Also special prerelease installer for beta testing versions.

## Linux

Check your distributions preferred package manager, if **LibreCAD** is available there. But the
version may be a bit older.

[ from GitHub ][24]
Find latest binary AppImage packages there.

## Build from source

**This is an option for all platforms.**

If we don't have the binary installer you are looking for, you can try to build **LibreCAD** from
source code.
How this works for each platform can be read in our [manual ][25].

Source code could be downloaded [ from GitHub][26] as ZIP archive.

Or you can clone or fork our repository, which is recommended if you plan to contribute.

# Join LibreCAD Community

The **LibreCAD** team is a small group of dedicated people. Lots of things have been worked out, but
plenty of bugs and features are still waiting to be solved. How can you help? We need all the skills
in the community as **coders**, **writers**, **testers** or **translators**.

An open source community is a dynamic thing; people come and go as their private situation drives or
stops them contributing. So, it will always help if you have existing resources we can use, know
what other projects do in specific areas, or, most importantly, do what you do best and have fun
doing it!

You don't have to sign a lifetime contract to contribute. Whether you can help others in the forum,
garden the wiki, or apply one or many patches, our broad user base will appreciate your work.

**Come join our community, and contribute in any way you like.**

## Develop

If you are an outstanding developer in C++ or a beginner we can use your help.
With a bit of determination, the IRC channel, Zulip chat and the Libre-CAD-dev mailing list, we can
help you get started and make progress.
All you need is linked in [download section ][27] and [top links ][28] above.

## Document

Developers usually make bad documentation for users, so if you like making documentation, great!
There are continuous GUI changes in LibreCAD that need to be documented.

## Translate

Help localize **LibreCAD**, we currently support over 30 languages.
Our translation server is over here: [translate.librecad.org/ ][29].
You can complete new languages, or request creating translations for a new language in the [forum
][30].

# LibreCAD Friends & Sponsors

As a non-profit, community driven open source project **LibreCAD** is dependent on having good
relationships with friends and sponsors.

## Friends

[

### BRL-CAD

[BRL-CAD Logo] ][31]

BRL-CAD is a powerful open source cross-platform solid modelling system that includes interactive
geometry editing, high-performance ray-tracing for rendering and geometric analysis, a system
performance analysis benchmark suite, geometry libraries for application developers, and more than
30 years of active development.

BRL-CAD and **LibreCAD** collaborate in Google programs. We participate under the umbrella of
BRL-CAD in [Google Code-in ][32] and [Google Summer of Code ][33] where we mentor school pupils and
students in participating in open source projects.

## Sponsors

A big **thank you** goes to all the supporters on [**Open Collective** ][34] and [**GitHub
Sponsors** ][35].
With their donations they make an important contribution to maintaining our community.

[

### Weblate

[Weblate Logo] ][36]

Weblate is an open-source, web-based, continuous localization platform. They generously provide us
with a free hosted instance for **LibreCAD** localization.

[

### Zulip

[Zulip Logo] ][37]

Zulip is an open-source modern team chat app designed to keep both live and asynchronous
conversations organized. They generously provide us with a free hosted instance for **LibreCAD**
community conversation.

[

### PCBWay

[PCBWay Logo] ][38]

PCBWay is a Chinese manufacturer, not only for Printed Circuit Boards, but also offering various
fabrication services, e.g. CNC machining, 3D printing or laser cutting.
Their services are available worldwide in more than 170 countries. Specialized in prototyping and
low-volume production, PCBWay is interesting for our community members, because they can transform
our drawings into real hardware.
They support us with financial donations and also provide a commission on orders placed via
**LibreCAD** affiliate links.

[ **DXF upload form to get a quote **][39]
DXF uploads are accepted for sheet metal fabrication, namely Laser cutting and Bending.

[

### Route4Me

[Route Planning and Route Mapping] ][40]

Route4Me is an innovative, open-source route planning and optimization platform designed for
businesses and individuals. With its powerful algorithms, Route4Me helps users efficiently plan
routes for deliveries, pickups, and service visits, saving time and fuel costs.
Route4Me offers a wide range of services, including real-time route adjustments, team communication
features, and integration with popular mapping and GPS solutions. They provide support for small and
large teams across various industries, from logistics to field services.
They provide us with a generous monthly donation on Open Collective.

## Document

Developers usually make bad documentation for users, so if you like making documentation, great!
There are continuous GUI changes in LibreCAD that need to be documented.

## Translate

Help localize **LibreCAD**, we currently support over 30 languages.
Our translation server is over here: [translate.librecad.org/ ][29].
You can complete new languages, or request creating translations for a new language in the [forum
][30].

# LibreCAD Friends & Sponsors

As a non-profit, community driven open source project **LibreCAD** is dependent on having good
relationships with friends and sponsors.

## Friends

[

### BRL-CAD

[BRL-CAD Logo] ][31]

BRL-CAD is a powerful open source cross-platform solid modelling system that includes interactive
geometry editing, high-performance ray-tracing for rendering and geometric analysis, a system
performance analysis benchmark suite, geometry libraries for application developers, and more than
30 years of active development.

BRL-CAD and **LibreCAD** collaborate in Google programs. We participate under the umbrella of
BRL-CAD in [Google Code-in ][32] and [Google Summer of Code ][33] where we mentor school pupils and
students in participating in open source projects.

## Sponsors

A big **thank you** goes to all the supporters on [**Open Collective** ][34] and [**GitHub
Sponsors** ][35].
With their donations they make an important contribution to maintaining our community.

[

### Weblate

[Weblate Logo] ][36]

Weblate is an open-source, web-based, continuous localization platform. They generously provide us
with a free hosted instance for **LibreCAD** localization.

[

### Zulip

[Zulip Logo] ][37]

Zulip is an open-source modern team chat app designed to keep both live and asynchronous
conversations organized. They generously provide us with a free hosted instance for **LibreCAD**
community conversation.

[

### PCBWay

[PCBWay Logo] ][38]

PCBWay is a Chinese manufacturer, not only for Printed Circuit Boards, but also offering various
fabrication services, e.g. CNC machining, 3D printing or laser cutting.
Their services are available worldwide in more than 170 countries. Specialized in prototyping and
low-volume production, PCBWay is interesting for our community members, because they can transform
our drawings into real hardware.
They support us with financial donations and also provide a commission on orders placed via
**LibreCAD** affiliate links.

[ **DXF upload form to get a quote **][39]
DXF uploads are accepted for sheet metal fabrication, namely Laser cutting and Bending.

[

### Route4Me

[Route Planning and Route Mapping] ][40]

Route4Me is an innovative, open-source route planning and optimization platform designed for
businesses and individuals. With its powerful algorithms, Route4Me helps users efficiently plan
routes for deliveries, pickups, and service visits, saving time and fuel costs.
Route4Me offers a wide range of services, including real-time route adjustments, team communication
features, and integration with popular mapping and GPS solutions. They provide support for small and
large teams across various industries, from logistics to field services.
They provide us with a generous monthly donation on Open Collective.

  nanoCAD 26
  
  Explore nanoCAD products used by thousands of designers and engineers across various industries
  such as mechanical engineering, building design, architecture, site design, and landscaping to
  streamline design, increase productivity, and improve document communications. Experience the full
  benefits of nanoCAD with a 30-day trial.
  
  nanoCAD 26 Platform
  
  nanoCAD 26 Platform is a professional-grade CAD platform fully compatible with the industry’s DWG
  standard. It offers the standard user interface with a wide set of tools for 2D/3D drafting that
  can be extended with modules specific to the needs of professionals in engineering, architecture,
  and construction.
  * [Overview][13]
  * [Features][14]
  * [What’s new][15]
  * [Download][16]
  
  3D Solid Modeling Module
  
  3D Solid Modeling module extends the nanoCAD platform with direct editing and parametric modeling.
  The module also offers 3D constraints for mating parts into 3D assemblies and provides tools for
  sheet metal modeling.
  * [Overview][17]
  * [Features][18]
  * [What’s new][19]
  * [Download][20]
  
  Mechanica Module
  
  Mechanica module extends the nanoCAD platform with 2D and 3D mechanical design. Its parametric
  engine works with the included library of standard parts, and the many built-in calculators
  generate drawings quickly.
  * [Overview][21]
  * [Features][22]
  * [What’s new][23]
  * [Download][24]
  
  Construction Module
  
  Construction module extends the nanoCAD platform with drafting utilities suitable for parametric
  designs in architecture, engineering, and construction. Its IFC support and parametric libraries
  of standard parts help automate construction drawings.
  * [Overview][25]
  * [Features][26]
  * [What’s new][27]
  * [Download][28]
  
  Raster Module
  
  Raster module extends the nanoCAD platform with tools designed specifically for handling raster
  images, including very large ones. These tools import, correct, skew, convert, colorize,
  vectorize, and smart select raster images.
  * [Overview][29]
  * [Features][30]
  * [Download][31]
  
  Topoplan Module
  
  Topoplan module extends the nanoCAD platform with digital terrain modeling. Surveyors can take
  advantage of tools that create and modify TINs, texture them with raster overlays, generate
  reliefs, and calculate volumes and areas.
  * [Overview][32]
  * [Features][33]
  * [What’s new][34]
  * [Download][35]
  
  nanoCAD 3DScan
  
  From Point Cloud to Precise Engineering
  Specialized software for processing 3D scan data into actionable models and documentation. Solve
  complex engineering tasks in construction, infrastructure, manufacturing, and surveying with
  powerful, dedicated tools.
  * [Overview][36]
  * [Features][37]
  * [Download][38]
  
  nanoCAD Free
  
  nanoCAD Free is the free version of nanoCAD that comes with a set of design tools for creating 2D
  engineering drawings and has no time limitations.
  * [Overview][39]
  * [Download][40]

Software Neowise

## Neowise: intelligenza artificiale e automazione per una diagnosi precisa

[software-neowise-header-card]

Neowise è il nuovo software di imaging intelligente che ottimizza l’analisi diagnostica con
strumenti AI avanzati.

Segmentazione automatica, analisi cefalometrica, tracciamento del nervo mandibolare e simulazioni
estetiche rendono il flusso di lavoro più veloce e preciso.

Un’interfaccia intuitiva e l’integrazione completa con i sistemi NEWTOM garantiscono efficienza e
sicurezza, nel pieno rispetto delle normative.

[ Scopri Neowise ][131]

Pionieri nel DNA

# Dispositivi radiologici CBCT e radiologia digitale

Fin dagli esordi, NEWTOM ha segnato il passo dell’innovazione nel settore dell’imaging medico,
introducendo la prima tecnologia CBCT per applicazioni odontoiatriche. Con una visione pionieristica
e un costante investimento in ricerca e sviluppo, l’azienda ha ampliato il proprio impatto in
diversi ambiti medici, ridefinendo gli standard di qualità e precisione diagnostica.  

Oggi, NEWTOM continua a essere un riferimento globale, sviluppando dispositivi radiologici
all’avanguardia e soluzioni dedicati per la diagnostica per immagini, con l’obiettivo di migliorare
la salute e il benessere dei pazienti in tutto il mondo.

# L’esperienza NEWTOM al servizio della diagnostica

NEWTOM offre dispositivi radiologici avanzati, progettati per l’imaging in tre ambiti specialistici:
**dentale**, **medicale** e **veterinario**. Le nostre tecnologie garantiscono immagini ad altissima
definizione, migliorando diagnosi, pianificazione e sicurezza per pazienti e specialisti in ogni
settore. 

[settore-dentale-card]

### Dentale

Soluzioni di imaging avanzato per diagnosi accurate, pianificazione dei trattamenti odontoiatrici e
massima protezione del paziente. 
[ Vai al settore ][133]
[settore-dent-card]

### Medicale

Strumenti di imaging ad alte prestazioni per una visione dettagliata dei distretti anatomici, a
supporto di diagnosi rapide e affidabili. 
[ Vai al settore ][134]
[settore-vet-card]

### Veterinario

Sistemi diagnostici dedicati alla medicina veterinaria, con immagini nitide e dettagliate per
garantire trattamenti mirati e tempestivi. 
[ Vai al settore ][135]

Formazione

## Massima autonomia con la giusta formazione

NEWTOM offre un servizio di formazione dedicato agli scanner intraorali, guidato dai nostri
specialisti di prodotto. Un percorso pensato per dimostrare le funzionalità di base del dispositivo
e della sua suite software, fornendo agli utenti tutte le competenze necessarie per operare in
completa autonomia. 

[
Scopri di più
][136]
Chi siamo

## I nostri prodotti

NEWTOM fornisce una gamma completa di dispositivi radiologici e soluzioni per l’imaging, dai sistemi
intraorali per acquisizioni rapide e precise, ai dispositivi extraorali per immagini diagnostiche
avanzate, fino a software innovativi per l’elaborazione e l’analisi. Strumenti versatili e di alta
qualità per una diagnostica all’avanguardia.

  efficiente.

Software Neowise

## Neowise: intelligenza artificiale e automazione per una diagnosi precisa

[software-neowise-header-card]

Neowise è il nuovo software di imaging intelligente che ottimizza l’analisi diagnostica con
strumenti AI avanzati.

Segmentazione automatica, analisi cefalometrica, tracciamento del nervo mandibolare e simulazioni
estetiche rendono il flusso di lavoro più veloce e preciso.

Un’interfaccia intuitiva e l’integrazione completa con i sistemi NEWTOM garantiscono efficienza e
sicurezza, nel pieno rispetto delle normative.

[ Scopri Neowise ][131]

Pionieri nel DNA

# Dispositivi radiologici CBCT e radiologia digitale

Fin dagli esordi, NEWTOM ha segnato il passo dell’innovazione nel settore dell’imaging medico,
introducendo la prima tecnologia CBCT per applicazioni odontoiatriche. Con una visione pionieristica
e un costante investimento in ricerca e sviluppo, l’azienda ha ampliato il proprio impatto in
diversi ambiti medici, ridefinendo gli standard di qualità e precisione diagnostica.  

Oggi, NEWTOM continua a essere un riferimento globale, sviluppando dispositivi radiologici
all’avanguardia e soluzioni dedicati per la diagnostica per immagini, con l’obiettivo di migliorare
la salute e il benessere dei pazienti in tutto il mondo.

# L’esperienza NEWTOM al servizio della diagnostica

NEWTOM offre dispositivi radiologici avanzati, progettati per l’imaging in tre ambiti specialistici:
**dentale**, **medicale** e **veterinario**. Le nostre tecnologie garantiscono immagini ad altissima
definizione, migliorando diagnosi, pianificazione e sicurezza per pazienti e specialisti in ogni
settore. 

[settore-dentale-card]

### Dentale

Soluzioni di imaging avanzato per diagnosi accurate, pianificazione dei trattamenti odontoiatrici e
massima protezione del paziente. 
[ Vai al settore ][133]
[settore-dent-card]

### Medicale

Strumenti di imaging ad alte prestazioni per una visione dettagliata dei distretti anatomici, a
supporto di diagnosi rapide e affidabili. 
[ Vai al settore ][134]
[settore-vet-card]

### Veterinario

Sistemi diagnostici dedicati alla medicina veterinaria, con immagini nitide e dettagliate per
garantire trattamenti mirati e tempestivi. 
[ Vai al settore ][135]

Formazione

## Massima autonomia con la giusta formazione

NEWTOM offre un servizio di formazione dedicato agli scanner intraorali, guidato dai nostri
specialisti di prodotto. Un percorso pensato per dimostrare le funzionalità di base del dispositivo
e della sua suite software, fornendo agli utenti tutte le competenze necessarie per operare in
completa autonomia. 

[
Scopri di più

Chi siamo

## I nostri prodotti

NEWTOM fornisce una gamma completa di dispositivi radiologici e soluzioni per l’imaging, dai sistemi
intraorali per acquisizioni rapide e precise, ai dispositivi extraorali per immagini diagnostiche
avanzate, fino a software innovativi per l’elaborazione e l’analisi. Strumenti versatili e di alta
qualità per una diagnostica all’avanguardia.

corporate transparency.

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## Trusted by Leading Brands
## Used by Over 2000 Companies

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

[ Search now ][44]
[ Plug in our data ][45]

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

DICOM viewer in the world. It is the result of more than 20 years of research and development in
digital imaging. It fully supports the DICOM standard for an easy integration in your workflow
environment and an open platform for development of processing tools. It offers advanced
post-processing techniques in 2D and 3D, exclusive innovative technique for 3D and 4D navigation and

best performances on the most modern processors. OsiriX MD, the commercial version, is certified for

[devices-osirix]

With high performance and an intuitive interactive user interface, OsiriX is the most widely used
DICOM viewer in the world. It is the result of more than 20 years of research and development in
digital imaging. It fully supports the DICOM standard for an easy integration in your workflow
environment and an open platform for development of processing tools. It offers advanced
post-processing techniques in 2D and 3D, exclusive innovative technique for 3D and 4D navigation and
a complete integration with any PACS. OsiriX supports 64-bit computing and multithreading for the
best performances on the most modern processors. OsiriX MD, the commercial version, is certified for
medical use (FDA cleared and CE II labeled).

More than a medical images viewer, OsiriX MD is a powerful diagnosis tool. OsiriX has been developed

Radiologists, Medical care providers, Institutions and many others.

## examination?

OsiriX Lite, the free demo version, offers the solution. Available for Mac computers running macOS,
OsiriX Lite empowers you to conveniently review your medical images from the comfort of your home.
Installation is swift and straightforward, ensuring a seamless experience.

access to MRI in emerging markets, technological innovation, and continued investment in healthcare
infrastructure, the market continues to face a complex operating environment. Procurement

20 Jul 2026: Medical Imaging
Global CT Market Outlook: Innovation Driving Growth Amid Economic And Geopolitical Uncertainty
The global CT market is forecast to experience low single-digit Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)
over the next five years, excluding growth attributed to Photon-Counting CT (PCCT). Year-on-year
growth in 2025 was slightly above flat due to a tempered market recovery in China and wider
geopolitical and supply chain uncertainty. However, manufacturers continue to operate against a
backdrop of economic uncertainty, geopolitical tensions, and pricing pressures that are influencing
purchasing decisions across many healthcare markets. As healthcare providers seek to balance
investment in advanced technologies with constrained budgets, the CT market is expected to
experience varying rates of growth across regions and customer segments.

20 Jul 2026: Medical Imaging
Global MRI Market Outlook: Expanding Access Despite Challenging Market Dynamics
The global MRI market is forecast to grow at a Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of
mid-single-digit percentage over the next five years. While growth will be underpinned by expanding
access to MRI in emerging markets, technological innovation, and continued investment in healthcare
infrastructure, the market continues to face a complex operating environment. Procurement
uncertainty, inflationary pressures, supply chain constraints, and geopolitical tensions remain key
challenges for manufacturers and providers alike. The full report (MRI Equipment – World – 2026)
examines the principal trends shaping the global MRI market, assessing the factors driving growth,
and the outlook across major regional markets.
[Arrow Right]
][105]
[
Insight
20 Jul 2026: Medical Imaging
Global CT Market Outlook: Innovation Driving Growth Amid Economic And Geopolitical Uncertainty
The global CT market is forecast to experience low single-digit Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)
over the next five years, excluding growth attributed to Photon-Counting CT (PCCT). Year-on-year
growth in 2025 was slightly above flat due to a tempered market recovery in China and wider
geopolitical and supply chain uncertainty. However, manufacturers continue to operate against a
backdrop of economic uncertainty, geopolitical tensions, and pricing pressures that are influencing
purchasing decisions across many healthcare markets. As healthcare providers seek to balance
investment in advanced technologies with constrained budgets, the CT market is expected to
experience varying rates of growth across regions and customer segments.
[Arrow Right]
][106]

15 Jul 2026: AI in Healthcare, Healthcare IT
AI in Medical Imaging News Round Up – June 2026
The medical imaging AI market saw sustained activity in June 2026, with draft reporting emerging as
one of the clearest near-term applications for foundation models. This Signify Research round-up
examines FDA milestones for Aidoc, HOPPR and Harrison.ai, growth investment in AIRS Medical, and the
partnerships, clearances, and data-infrastructure moves shaping AI adoption across imaging
workflows.
[Arrow Right]
][107]
[
Insight
14 Jul 2026: Healthcare IT, Medical Imaging
Imaging IT News Round Up – June 2026
Radiology reporting dominated imaging IT news in June 2026, with DeepHealth, HOPPR, and Raidium all
launching AI-enabled reporting solutions, while RADPAIR announced a partnership with Fujifilm
Healthcare Americas. DataFirst introduced a new data standardisation platform, while easyRadiology
and 3VEREST extended their existing cloud partnership into the UK-Ireland market. This round-up from
Signify Research's Healthcare IT team tracks the vendor moves shaping imaging IT adoption heading
into the second half of 2026.
[Arrow Right]
][108]
[
Insight
14 Jul 2026: Clinical Care
Clinical Care News Round-up – June 2026
Clinical care market activity accelerated in June 2026, with major regulatory and commercial
announcements from Medtronic, Masimo, and Sibel Health, alongside continued AI ECG momentum in
Europe. Based on Signify Research analysis, this insight examines FDA clearances for Nellcor pulse
oximetry and Masimo Radius VSM, Sibel Health's EU MDR Class IIb CE Mark for ANNE One, and new NMT
platforms from IDMed/Draeger and Senzime.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

Sci-Hub is the most controversial project in today science. The goal of Sci-Hub is to provide **free
and unrestricted** access to all scientific knowledge ever published in journal or book form.

Today the circulation of knowledge in science is restricted by high prices. Many students and
researchers cannot afford academic journals and books that are locked behind paywalls. Sci-Hub
emerged in 2011 to tackle this problem. Since then, the website has revolutionized the way science
is being done.

Sci-Hub is helping millions of students and researchers, medical professionals, journalists and
curious people in all countries to unlock access to knowledge. The mission of Sci-Hub is to fight
every obstacle that prevents open access to knowledge: be it legal, technical or otherwise.

To get more information visit the [about Sci-Hub][56] section.

Today the circulation of knowledge in science is restricted by high prices. Many students and
researchers cannot afford academic journals and books that are locked behind paywalls. Sci-Hub
emerged in 2011 to tackle this problem. Since then, the website has revolutionized the way science
is being done.

Sci-Hub is helping millions of students and researchers, medical professionals, journalists and
curious people in all countries to unlock access to knowledge. The mission of Sci-Hub is to fight
every obstacle that prevents open access to knowledge: be it legal, technical or otherwise.

To get more information visit the [about Sci-Hub][56] section.

Rahul Shah, Co-Founder & Director

Rahul brings more than 20 years of industry experience, out of which, he has spent more than 17
years in the Executive Search industry. After his MBA, he worked for close to 3 years in the Steel
Industry with Usha Martin and then moved to the Executive Search industry with ABC Consultants. He
spent more than 9 years with ABC Consultants and was last designated as an Executive Director
responsible for running the Bangalore office, the 3rd largest office by revenues.

As Co-Founder of WalkWater, he personally leads Senior Searches across sectors, with a sectoral
specialisation in the Consumer, Pharma and Industrial sectors. In this exciting career, he has had
the opportunity of working as a Trusted Talent Advisor with senior candidates and with a variety of
clients across sectors – large Indian Conglomerates, Blue Chip MNCs, Emerging Companies and
Mid-sized firms.

He is an Instrumentation Engineer from Bangalore University and has completed his MBA from XIM,
Bhubaneswar. He is certified in Personal Profile Analysis from Thomas International.

Outside work, he is a biker and loves to travel and watch movies.

×
Kunal Girap, Co-Founder & Director

With over two decades of experience, Kunal leads senior searches across multiple sectors and is a
trusted advisor to global business leaders in the Industry. He leads the Automotive, Aerospace &
Defense, Process & Infrastructure practices for the firm with teams spread across India & US. Kunal
is also architecting WalkWater’s digital journey and is passionate about technology and its impact
on the executive search process.

He has multifaceted background in Project Management, Industrial Sales & Marketing, Manufacturing
and Consulting that enables him to relate with candidates and clients across diverse sectors. Kunal
worked with Tyco International, Hindalco and ABC Consultants before Co-founding WalkWater.

A graduate in Mechanical Engineering and Executive Management Program from IIM Bangalore, Kunal is a
sports & fitness enthusiast and plays active club cricket in Mumbai. Kunal is a Rotarian and quite
passionate about giving it back to the society through the Rotary platform.

×
Harold D’Souza, Co-Founder & Director

Harold has worked in the Executive Search industry since 1998 , when the industry was still
developing into an important part of the corporate world. He has been part of the evolution of the
search industry and over the last two decades has contributed to its current stature and
positioning.

Before co-founding WalkWater, he was responsible for building the Technology Industry Practice in
India for Accord Group India and DHR International. Earlier experiences has been with E&Y and PSS.
His key expertise is building revenue and profit generating search businesses from scratch; and
developing long standing relationships with leaders, across industry sectors.

A special area of focus is Indian Business Houses and entrepreneur driven companies. Harold also
leads CEO and leadership searches, especially in Technology and related sectors. He also works
closely with many start-ups and founders.

Harold is a firm believer in the power of instinct in personal and professional life. He is also an
avid foodie, loves to cook and travel; and a keen squash player. He is also a non-fiction book lover
and owns a huge collection of books at his home in Bangalore.

×
Ashutosh Khanna, Co-Founder & Director

Ashu has more than 20 years of experience out of which he has spent 18+ years in the Executive
Search industry. Before co-founding WalkWater, Ashu led the Technology Practice at Korn/Ferry
FutureStep. During his career in the industry, he has successfully partnered with numerous
organisations on building their leadership team across India, US, Europe and South East Asia. He has
had the privilege to work with well-known Leaders of large firms (MNC/ Indian) as well as Founders
of Startup organizations across Technology and Consumer sectors.

With PGD in International Business from Symbiosis, Mechanical Engineering from Bangalore University
and Diploma in Consumer Protection Laws, Ashu is also certified in Competency based interviewing
from SHL and Right Management, Personality Profiling from Thomas International and Coaching Skills
by Results Coaching, Australia.

Besides work, he loves to read, play, travel and do long distance running.

From Wikidata

**Welcome to Wikidata**

the [free][408] knowledge base with [122,560,304][409] data [entities][410] that
[anyone can edit][411].

[Introduction][412] • [Project Chat][413] • [Community Portal][414] • [Help][415]

**Want to help translate? [Translate the missing messages][416].**

Welcome!

Wikidata is a free and open knowledge base that can be read and edited by both humans and machines.

Wikidata acts as central storage for the **structured data** of its Wikimedia sister projects
including Wikipedia, Wikivoyage, Wiktionary, Wikisource, and others.

Wikidata also provides support to many other sites and services beyond just Wikimedia projects! The
content of Wikidata is [available under a free license][417], [exported using standard
formats][418], and [can be interlinked to other open data sets][419] on the linked data web.

Get involved
For a complete starters’ guide, visit the **[community portal][420].**

**Learn about Wikidata**
* What is Wikidata? Read the **[Wikidata introduction][421]**.
* Explore Wikidata by looking at a featured showcase item for author **[Douglas Adams (Q42)][422]**.
* Get started with Wikidata's **[SPARQL query service][423]**.

**Contribute to Wikidata**
* Learn to edit Wikidata: follow the **[tutorials][424]**.
* Work with other volunteers on a subject that interests you: **[join a WikiProject][425]**.
* Individuals and organizations can also **[donate data][426]**.

**Meet the Wikidata community**
* Visit the **[community portal][427]** or attend a **[Wikidata event][428]**.
* Create a **[user account][429]**.
* Talk and ask questions on the **[Project chat][430]**, **[Telegram groups][431]**, or the **[live
  IRC chat][432]**^{[connect][433]}.

**Use data from Wikidata**
* Learn how you can **[retrieve and use data from Wikidata][434]**.

[More...][435]
News
* 📢 [WikiProject Days 2026][436] took place from June 19 to 21 online. We talked about how
  WikiProjects can be used as a space to connect with others and inform data modelling and quality
  decisions. Sessions included how to make Wikiprojects more visible, create guidelines for good
  WikiProjects, and bring life back into neglected WikiProjects. Everyone was welcome. Sessions were
  recorded. You can watch them from Wikimedia Commons and take a look at the presentation slides
  used in the event.
* Mobile editors can now edit all datatypes directly in the mobile view. To help improve this new
  interface, Wikimedia Deutschland is looking for volunteers (especially editors from right-to-left
  languages) for UX testing sessions. Participants will be compensated for their time. [Sign up
  here][437] and learn more on the project page: [Mobile editing of statements][438].
* 2025-11-12: [Temporary accounts][439] were deployed on Wikidata. From now on unregistered editors
  will get a temporary account automatically assigned to them, instead of being identified by their
  IP addresses.
